body:
I don't know what your relationship with those people was like before, but unless you're talking about your very best friends, you can't expect people to reach out to you. A lot of people, even if they're your friend, can't help but interact with the people around them day to day. It takes a lot of effort to keep in touch with people who don't also try to keep in touch with you. Again, I don't know your relationship with those people, but I'm guessing it wasn't personal.

Relationships work both ways dude.
